subject.title: feat(tools): introduce group:core for all built-in core tools

question: Should `group:core` automatically include future core-owned tool factories for users who persist this allow or deny entry?
rationale: The latest code correctly implements the current all-core contract, but automatic permission growth across future upgrades is a durable product, compatibility, and security decision that implementation evidence cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve descriptor-wide membership
options.body: Document that every current and future core-owned factory joins `group:core`, while normal feature, runtime, provider, and ownership gates continue to apply.

options.title: Require explicit group classification
options.body: Add a separately reviewed membership property so each future core factory must deliberately opt into the broad group.

options.title: Decline the broad alias
options.body: Keep `tools.profile: full` and the narrower existing groups if maintainers do not want another durable high-privilege policy surface.

recommendation.title: Approve descriptor-wide membership
recommendation.body: Document that every current and future core-owned factory joins `group:core`, while normal feature, runtime, provider, and ownership gates continue to apply.

likelyOwner.reason: The original data-driven tool catalog and its group/profile taxonomy appear to date to Tak Hoffman's merged catalog work, making them the best available owner for the permanent group semantics.
